title: The Life Transforming Flame
summary: The gray-robed man is Han Feng, Yao Lao's traitor disciple, who survived and is now a Dou Zong working for the Hall of Souls. He mocks Xiao Yan for losing Yao Lao to the Hall of Souls, and Xiao Yan swears to kill him. Old Ying Shan, facing four Dou Zongs, throws the Bodhisattva Body Transformation Saliva into the crowd, and it ends up with Xiao Yan. Xiao Yan offers Mo Tian Xing the Zong Breaking Pill to stay out, but Han Feng wins him over instead. Su Qian takes on Han Feng, and Little Fairy Doctor and Zi Yan face the others. Fang Yan and his two brothers use the Flame Creation Skill to form the Life Transforming Flame and then the Star Fire Phoenix. Xiao Yan breaks it with his Heavenly Flame and moves to take the flame for himself.
